page.overview:
Who is Eldacar?

Eldacar was the fourth High King of Arnor.

Eldacar was born in TA 87, son of the High King of Arnor Valandil, and through his father, he was the grandson of Isildur. He himself ascended to the throne of Arnor in TA 249 with the death of his father. His reign was without any significant event and Eldacar died in TA 339 at an age of 252, after reigning for ninety years. He was succeeded by his son Arantar.

The name Eldacar means "Elf-helm" in the Quenya language.
